```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><style>body { color: red; }</style></head><body><style>.foo { margin: 0; }</style></body></html>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
}
```
